title: Tor-amplitude gap forces derived tensor cohomology to vanish
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let P be a perfect object of D(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex] with Tor amplitude in [u,v], and let L be a complex with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-pc-derived-category]. For every integer j, if H^q(L)=0 for all q in [j-v,j-u], then H^j(P\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}L)=0.
